Class WorldEditorPane

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
org.swarmforge.client.ui.BaseWorldEditorPane
org.swarmforge.client.ui.WorldEditorPane
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class WorldEditorPane extends BaseWorldEditorPane
World Editor Pane for SwarmForge Studio. Synchronized 3D, Top-Down, and Side views, procedural terrain, soil substrates, micro-hydrology, species adaptation, and simulation overlays.
